## Analysis overview

Selects ADAS-Cog total records at key visits, distinguishes LOCF and windowed records, calculates descriptive statistics for values and changes, and arranges results by visit and treatment.

## ADaM datasets

- `ADQSADAS`

## Key ADaM variables

- `PARAMCD`: ACTOT parameter
- `AVISIT/AVISITN`: analysis visit
- `AVAL`: analysis value
- `BASE`: baseline value
- `CHG`: change from baseline
- `DTYPE`: derivation type
- `EFFFL/ITTFL/ANL01FL`: selection flags
- `TRTP/TRTPN`: planned treatment.
